notes:
Thank you for reviewing Letzte Runde (German UI).

WHAT IT IS
A cooperative card game based on Texas Hold'em hand rankings: players do not compete, they try together to rank their hands from weakest to strongest using numbered chips, without talking about their cards. No betting, no real money, no ads. Optional tips via in-app purchase (consumable, unlocks nothing).

HOW TO REVIEW (no account needed)
- Singleplayer: on the start screen tap "Spielen" next to "Singleplayer". You play against bots; this works fully offline (airplane mode). Take a chip, tap "Bereit", repeat for 4 rounds, then see the result.
- Multiplayer online: enter a name, tap "Raum erstellen", then "Bot hinzufügen" twice and "Hand geben" to play a room with bots. To test with a second device, share the invite link (browser or app).
- Local network without internet: tap "Spielort" > "Im WLAN hosten". The app runs its own game server on the device; other devices join via QR code (camera permission is only used to scan this code) or the local network search (local network permission).

NOT A WEB WRAPPER
The complete game (rules engine, bots, encrypted dealing) is bundled and runs on the device. The app embeds a Node.js runtime that hosts games for nearby devices without internet, uses native haptics, Bonjour discovery and QR scanning. The online server is only used for internet multiplayer and optional accounts.

USER-GENERATED CONTENT (Guideline 1.2)
Rooms have a text chat and user-chosen names. Safeguards:
- Filter: chat messages, player names and room names pass a server-side word filter for slurs and profanity.
- Report: tap "⋯" next to any player > "Melden" (reason buttons). Reports reach the operator with the room's recent chat; the operator reviews them within 24 hours and can close rooms or delete accounts.
- Block: in the same menu, "Stummschalten" hides that player's chat, bubbles and reactions on this device permanently.
- The room host can remove players (✕). Rooms are private by default (4-letter code).
- Contact: kontakt@simongutjahr.de

TIPS (in-app purchase)
Start screen, bottom: "💛 Unterstützen" opens three consumable tips (unlock nothing). There are no external payment or donation links in the iOS app.

GAME UPDATES WITHOUT A NEW BINARY (Guideline 2.5.2 / 3.3.1)
The game interface and rules engine are web content (HTML/JavaScript) running in WKWebView. The app can download a newer version of this content from our own server (signed with Ed25519, checked before use) after the user confirms a prompt at start; it does not change the app's purpose or add features beyond the game. The game version shipped in the binary always works without any connection.

ACCOUNTS
Optional (name + password, no e-mail). Accounts can be deleted in the app: "Konto & Statistik" > "Konto verwalten" > "Konto löschen".

ENCRYPTION
Uses only standard encryption (HTTPS/TLS, Web Crypto ECDH + AES-GCM for fair card dealing) provided by the OS/standard libraries; ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO.

Source code: https://github.com/sgitaize/letzte-runde
